raw_blocks: Powering Auto Transport Across North America

Proficient Auto Logistics is a leading freight company backed by the industry’s best auto transport and logistics providers. With one of the largest fleets in North America, we specialize in moving finished vehicles from production plants, ports, and rail hubs to a national network of dealerships.
We Are Proficient Auto Logistics ("PAL")

Proficient Auto Logistics is built to serve the nation’s automotive supply chain at scale. Powered by seven established operating companies and a network of strategically located terminals, we provide dependable transport for the world’s leading automakers across the country’s most critical production, distribution, and retail markets.
Our strength lies in integration—bringing together deep industry experience, broad geographic reach, and long-standing customer partnerships to move vehicles with consistency, safety, and efficiency.
Your Next Stop? A Career with No Limits.
With over 1,650 employees and operations across 90+ locations, PAL is rapidly expanding to meet the growing needs of the automotive industry.

We offer a wide range of opportunities—from driving and logistics to terminal operations and corporate roles—all backed by long-term stability and a dynamic, forward-moving team. At PAL and its operating companies, you can build a lasting career with impact, momentum, and nationwide reach.
Our North American Network Can Handle It All

At Proficient Auto Logistics, we offer a range of specialty services across our network to meet your unique needs. Whether it’s custom transport solutions, expedited shipping, or secure storage, with real-time tracking we can accommodate many vehicle transport and logistics requests.
We Let the Numbers Do the Talking
From nationwide coverage to industry-leading delivery performance, our metrics reflect the strength, scale, and precision of our logistics network.
With logistics expertise at every level
Expertly managed, end to end
Placed to maximize reach and efficiency
Plus brokerage, equipment, and maintenance
With additional outside capacity readily available
Automotive OEMs Served for U.S. Transport
Trusted by the world’s leading automakers
Shaping the Future of Auto Logistics

As a publicly traded company, PAL unites nine established auto transport and logistics providers under one powerful brand. We are committed to long-term growth and operational excellence, delivering consistent value to our customers, employees, and shareholders.

Visit our Investor Relations portal for the latest company news, financial reports, and governance updates. We invite investors, analysts, and partners to explore how PAL is shaping the future of auto logistics.
A leader in finished vehicle transportation

Proficient Auto Logistics offers a full spectrum of auto transportation and logistics services. From leading automotive manufacturers and electric vehicle producers to auto dealers, auctions, rental car companies, and leasing providers, we work with a range of global customers on transport into and across the U.S. and Canada.
If you have a need, we have a solution. Explore our services and discover how we can meet the transportation demands of any size or scope.
Stay informed with the latest announcements, acquisitions, and milestones from across the Proficient Auto Logistics network.

raw_blocks: Headquartered in Jacksonville, Florida, Proficient Auto Logistics is a trusted national leader in finished vehicle transport. With an operating fleet of over 1,350 trucks, we ship more than four million units annually across the U.S. and Canada – safely, efficiently, and with customer service standards at the forefront. We’re a key partner for 100% of global OEMs who serve the domestic market, including dealerships, auctions, fleet providers, and EV manufacturers.

Comprised of nine operating companies organized into two regions and supported by over 1,650 logistics professionals, we deliver seamless national coverage, while maintaining the flexibility to meet local demands.
To create long-term value and drive meaningful connections for our customers, employees, and shareholders by delivering safe, reliable auto logistics.
Driven by people and powered by innovation, we are the trusted leader in auto logistics, creating new horizons together.
We deliver on expectations. Excellence is the driving force of everything we do.
Safety is everyone’s responsibility. We protect people, cargo, and communities – and it’s the cornerstone of our reputation.
We win together. By working collaboratively and respectfully, we deliver better results.
We do what’s right, even when it’s hard. Integrity guides our actions and produces consistent outcomes.
We listen and respond with care. Great service builds strong relationships and positive customer experiences.

With 90+ strategically located facilities and nine operating companies working as one integrated system, our network delivers unmatched service across every region. By combining local expertise with national coverage, we ensure your vehicles are transported quickly, safely, and efficiently—no matter the distance.
Strategically located facility network with close proximity to major plants, ports and rail hubs

pages.raw_meta: PAL specializes in new vehicle delivery to dealerships, but we’re built to handle much more. We serve OEMs, EV makers, dealers, auctions, rental fleets, and
raw_blocks: PAL specializes in new vehicle delivery to dealerships, but we’re built to handle much more. We serve OEMs, EV makers, dealers, auctions, rental fleets, and leasing providers with full-spectrum transport services. And with dedicated repair facilities operated by Proficient Repair Services, we keep our fleet running reliably—and support external fleets—to meet transport needs of any size or complexity.
new vehicle transport to dealerships

We specialize in secure, timely delivery of brand-new vehicles directly from manufacturers, rail terminals, or ports to dealerships across both the United States and Canada. Our team understands the high standards required for new inventory, striving to deliver every vehicle in pristine condition and on schedule.
Open Carrier Shipping for All Vehicle Types

The open carrier service is the most popular and cost-effective method for transporting standard vehicles across both short and long distances. With a fleet of modern, well-maintained trucks and highly trained drivers, Proficient Auto Logistics ensures that vehicles are delivered safely and on schedule.
Enclosed Transport for Luxury, Classic & Exotic Cars​

For vehicles requiring premium protection, the enclosed car shipping service offers the highest level of care. Ideal for luxury, vintage, and high-performance automobiles, enclosed trailers shield vehicles from weather conditions, road debris, and public exposure throughout the journey.
North American Coverage for Vehicle Transport

Proficient Auto Logistics provides efficient vehicle transport services for individuals, businesses, and fleet operators throughout the United States and Canada. With integrated route planning, real-time tracking, and dispatch, every delivery is executed with security, precision, and timeliness.
Fast, Professional Dealer Relocation & Lot Transport​

The dealer relocation service supports the seamless transfer of vehicles between showroom locations, satellite branches, auctions, and partner sites. Designed to minimize downtime and maintain availability, this service meets the precision and speed demanded by auto dealers.
Custom Solutions for Every Transport Need

Whether managing large-scale dealer relocations or specialized one-off shipments, Proficient Auto Logistics offers tailored transport solutions that align with clients’ exact requirements. Each move is handled with industry expertise and an unwavering focus on reliability and care.

Proficient Auto Logistics brings together a powerful network of specialized, fully integrated companies across the United States and Canada. With shared values, systems, and expertise, our teams operate as one — delivering consistent, high-quality vehicle transport with nationwide strength and precision. Explore how our unified approach sets a new standard in automotive logistics.
